turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. What happened?
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Hale, "mm-hm" isn't an answer. I'm writing down that I asked twice. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
"I stopped listening about five minutes ago." I'm writing that down, Hale, exactly as you said it. Withdraw the zero, or the next person who hears it is the principal.
